metric: Native persona-goal success, physical nonfixture evidence, valid and faithful execution, no timeout and no controller error. Scored policy errors fail.
aggregation: Mean observed trials within each observed persona, then mean observed personas within each task, then mean of all 100 tasks. This differs from pooled episode success.
missingData: Infrastructure errors remain unscored. Three entirely unobserved Opus API personas are excluded from the conditional task means; all 100 tasks have some observed data.

source.sourceMethod: Displayed point estimates follow the current CoRL paper figure imported from Overleaf. Five archived strict report files were SHA-256-verified and their success counts and task-balanced means independently recomputed as archived evidence. Those archive checks do not independently recompute the paper's revised Astra high or Gemini points; no matching current Gemini trial-count bundle is included.

notes: The current paper author-reported Astra high point is33.2%. Its archived strict trial records below yield30.1667% task-balanced success; this archival row does not validate or recompute the revised point.
Per-persona counts permit independent reproduction of the archived means. Pooled successes / scored is a different weighting and does not define the displayed task-balanced metric.
No illustrative interval is exposed as a confidence interval. Fable has no reported result and is not assigned a score.

The current CoRL Gemini point is 30.4%; its source is the Overleaf-imported figure. The older arXiv aggregate of 26.2% and 2,168/2,170 coverage is retained only as a historical paper reference, not as current-point trial evidence.

configurations.note: The current CoRL figure reports 30.4%. Its underlying current trial counts and numerical confidence interval are not available in this website archive; no counts are inferred from the plotted percentage.

historicalPaperResult.note: This older arXiv aggregate is a separate paper statistic. Its coverage and interval do not establish or reproduce the current CoRL figure point of 30.4%.
